definitions.short: properly, to inclose (as a room), i.e. (by analogy,) to beset (as in a siege)
definitions.full: H2314. chadar [ חָדַר ] verb surround, enclose (Phoenician in derivatives; Arabic II. conceal , curtain concealing a person, chamber, house, or tent as concealing some one; Ethiopic dwell ; see also following) **Phoenician is only חדרת חדר, (temple or sepulchral) chamber (Lzb 271 Cooke 126 ); Ezek 21:19 is best explained from Syriac go about, surround , Syriac around. It seems uncertain whether חֶדֶר , Phoenician חדר chamber , Arabic curtain, chamber, tent , etc., are (ultimately) from this √ (as something surrounding ); or (Buhl) from II. חדר = II. conceal behind curtain, conceal, confine , IV. conceal oneself , also abide, stay, remain behind (Land 707f. ), Ethiopic abide, dwell (Driver, privately, Nov. 1905). — only Qal Participle feminine singular לָהֶם הַחֹדֶ֫רֶת Ezek 21:19 that which surroundeth them (of the sword), — so ᵑ6 Thes Sm Co Da VB.

occurrences.englishText: “Also, you son of man, appoint two ways, that the sword of the king of Babylon may come. They both will come out of one land, and mark out a place. Mark it out at the head of the way to the city.
